preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
Each test case integer n must be between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] != i + 1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p must be good, meaning no element is equal to its index plus one.
The output permutation p must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: p == sorted(p) and p != list(range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p must be the lexicographically smallest good permutation.
